name: Report to Zor
summary: Nazeer Bloodpike sends you to Orgrimmar with Marg's jeweled pendant. Strange that common soldiers carried such a fine piece, he asks Zor Lonetree, who knows Alliance politics, to judge its history.

sections.title: A Noble's Pendant
sections.body: Nazeer Bloodpike finds it strange that common soldiers carried a pendant so fine. Perhaps its owner was in disguise, or perhaps the soldiers stole it themselves. Either way, Nazeer judges it a noble's pendant. Its true owner must be found to unravel the mystery. Zor Lonetree in Orgrimmar knows much of Alliance politics and can tell whether Stormwind's nobility once claimed it.

sections.title: Zor's Verdict
sections.body: Zor Lonetree admires the great skill behind the pendant. Orcs would have no use for such a jewel, he says, though many humans would. Zor will have it studied and hopes its mysteries come to light in time.

faq.q: Why is the pendant being taken to Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: Nazeer Bloodpike judges it a noble's pendant. Zor Lonetree in Orgrimmar knows much of Alliance politics and can tell whether it has a history among Stormwind's nobles.

faq.q: Who previously had the jeweled pendant?
aliases: where did the pendant come from
faq.answer: Marg stole the pendant from soldiers at an Alliance camp near Theramore. Nazeer finds it strange that common soldiers carried it and wonders whether its owner was in disguise or the soldiers stole it.
Before this, Marg told you in Marg Speaks that he stole the pendant from soldiers camped near Theramore.
